text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need a consolidated launch narrative and updated website copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private. Goals: 1) launch posts (social + blog), 2) webinar creative & registration flows, 3) benchmark narrative (latency + cost), 4) inbound lead routing (web form -> SDR vs AE) and lead tags. Want to ship copy by EOD Wed.

Samir Patel: For web copy, propose 3 hero variants: Performance-first (latency/cost), Ops-first (SLA & rollouts), Hybrid (developer + economics). Which do we prioritize?

Jorge Alvarez: I’d push Performance-first for devs; include a small benchmark callout — conservative wording: 'sub-200ms p95 on short sequences with optimized routing'. Webinar idea: 'Predictable inference at scale' demo :thumbsup: 

Elaine Park: CTA mapping — Hosted -> 'Start free', Dedicated -> 'Request capacity', Private -> 'Contact sales'. Inbound routing: map 'Request capacity' -> AE queue; 'Contact sales' -> Enterprise AE; 'Start free' -> PLG nurture. Also add hidden tags: tenant_size, security_need, region.

Samir Patel: Draft social snippets: 
- Twitter: "Launch: predictable, economical LLM inference — across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Join the webinar." 
- LinkedIn long-form: blog + benchmark highlights.
Blog outline: intro, benchmarks, migration story, cost tradeoffs, CTA matrix. We should include a small benchmark table and an explainer on batching & caching.

Maya Chen: Timeline: Samir -> draft social + blog outline by Tue EOD. Elaine -> CTAs + routing by Tue afternoon. Jorge -> webinar demo script + 3 slides. I’ll collate and send to design Wed morning. @Samir @Elaine @Jorge please flag blockers.

Marketing Bot: Added checklist to #marketing-ops and updated forms repo. Tagging rules added: tier:enterprise, interest:dedicated, deployed:private. Snippet from /ops/forms.yaml:
```
routes:
  - path: /request-capacity -> queue: ae-enterprise
  - path: /start -> queue: onboarding-nurture
  - path: /contact -> queue: ae-enterprise
```

Jorge Alvarez: Proposed webinar title: "Serving With Confidence: Cost & Latency Tradeoffs" — 45m + 15m Q/A. Moderator: Maya. Panelists: Samir + Eng PM. Also propose a short prereg survey asking deployment type and estimated qps.

Elaine Park: Quick copy note — avoid committing to precise numbers in hero. Use phrases like "industry-leading p95 latency" and link to benchmarks page for details/footnotes. We'll validate any concrete claims with Eng before publish.

Maya Chen: Agree — conservative language in hero, concrete numbers only in benchmark page with methodology. Finalize copy by Wed EOD. Thanks all :spiral_calendar:
